lifecycle_note: Hosted Personal Assistant Platform shut down: final export and switch-off from 2026-11-07; downloads close and hosted data is deleted 2026-12-13 (vendor's shutdown page, checked 2026-11-16).

updates.new: Originally an enterprise LLM development platform (prompts, workflows, evals). It pivoted to a personal AI assistant (open-source vellum-assistant plus Vellum Cloud). Vellum shut down its hosted Personal Assistant Platform: per its shutdown page, hosted assistants are switched off after a final export on 2026-11-07, and downloads close and hosted data is deleted on 2026-12-13. Vellum no longer actively maintains the open-source repo; a founding engineer maintains a fork, Cadet, for self-hosters.

lifecycle_note: EVI and TTS APIs shut down 2026-11-13 as announced; by 2026-11-16 Hume's EVI and TTS doc pages redirect to its Audio Decisions API docs, the homepage no longer lists them, and the EVI API endpoint returns 404.

updates.new: Hume's Empathic Voice Interface (EVI) — voice agent platform with vocal-affect understanding, using Hume's proprietary speech-prosody models. Hume shut down the EVI and TTS APIs on 2026-11-13, as announced in its docs; by 2026-11-16 its EVI and TTS doc pages redirect to the Audio Decisions API docs. Hume raised $50M Series B Mar-2024 (EQT).
EVI 3 and EVI 4-mini (final); the EVI API shut down on 2026-11-13
